data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescPlugin
data.value: Plugin Server: Plugins are added to the server side (no client changes needed), extending functionality by modifying the server internals. This makes it easy to manage the server and players (e.g., permission groups, ban systems), but cannot modify client content, making it hard to add new items (only texture pack changes are possible).

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescHybridNeoForge
data.value: Plugin-Mod Hybrid Server (Forge loader): Combines plugin server and Forge server. Benefits: server management via plugins, new items/gameplay via mods. Drawbacks: instability, high risk of conflicts between plugins and mods, and client-server mod sync required.

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescHybridFabric
data.value: Plugin-Mod Hybrid Server (Fabric loader): Combines plugin server and Fabric server. Benefits: server management via plugins, new items/gameplay via mods. Drawbacks: instability, high risk of conflicts between plugins and mods, and client-server mod sync required.

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescModNeoForge
data.value: Mod Server (Forge loader): Uses Forge loader to add mods (both server and client required). Can modify both server and client content, enabling features impossible with plugin servers. However, plugin-based management is difficult, and client mods must sync with server mods.

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescModFabric
data.value: Mod Server (Fabric loader): Uses Fabric loader to add mods (both server and client required). Can modify both server and client content, enabling features impossible with plugin servers. However, plugin-based management is difficult, and client mods must sync with server mods.

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescVanilla
data.value: Vanilla Server: Mojang's pure native server. No plugins or mods can be added. A pure vanilla experience.

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescBedrock
data.value: Bedrock Edition Server: Designed for Bedrock Edition. Configuration differs from Java Edition servers, and the launcher has limited compatibility. Config file changes must be done manually. (Only supports Nukkit here; for official BDS, go back and select Custom Mode!)

data.name: Page_CreateServer_SrvDescProxy
data.value: Proxy Server: A forwarding server for Java Edition server groups. Acts as a bridge to transfer players between servers. You must first set up a regular server since proxy servers have no game content. Players cannot enter without a regular server to connect to. Currently, the launcher doesn't fully support this type; after creation, right-click the server in the list and use "Command Line Launch" to start it.
